name: easygenerator
description: Full-stack scaffold: NestJS API + React/Vite web sharing Zod schemas via path aliases.

scripts.postinstall: pnpm -C apps/api install && pnpm -C apps/web install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "pnpm -C apps/api dev" "pnpm -C apps/web dev"
scripts.build: pnpm -C apps/api build && pnpm -C apps/web build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm -C apps/api typecheck && pnpm -C apps/web typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm -C apps/api test && pnpm -C apps/web test
